b) Reference: the bacon strips are about 15-18 cm long. Across the plate (roughly 340 px wide in the image) the plate spans about 1.9-2 strip-lengths, which gives about 25-30 cm. Trusting the plate-type estimate more, I take width ≈ 24 cm.

- Some residual grease smears on the plate are negligible (a few grams at most, not counted separately).

STEP 4 - Hidden food: none; the bacon lies flat on the plate surface with no base layer.

STEP 5 - Energy: cooked bacon is about 540-600 kcal per 100 g (crisp, fatty). Using 550 kcal/100 g.

Total ≈ 25 g of cooked bacon, about 140 kcal.
